brand.purpose: The name only: Bebas Neue 400 uppercase at letter-spacing 0; 26px in the nav (2px top padding, 22px below 860px), 24px in the footer in Ink. The same face sets the decorative MH monogram on the mobile menu sheet at 56px, letter-spacing 0, in Line. Free stand-in for the reference's custom logotype.

headline.purpose: Plate and gallery titles: Pinyon Script 400, all lowercase, letter-spacing 0, line-height 1.15; plates fixed at 40px below 860px. Free stand-in for Shelley Script.

headline-contact.purpose: The contact title, one step larger than the plate titles.

menu.purpose: The five links of the open mobile menu sheet, centered, 6px apart.

title.purpose: The Media band heading, in Grey, centered.

body.purpose: Paragraphs at max 34-40ch in Text soft, centered; form input and textarea text in Ink via font: inherit. Free stand-in for Nicolas Cochin EF.

label.purpose: All chrome (.caps): nav links, plate links, gallery counter (tabular numerals) and captions, field labels, submit, the MENU label on the mobile sheet, all footer text. Free stand-in for ITC Kabel.

imageFilters.name: hero
imageFilters.purpose: Hero triptych photographs only; no overlay.

imageFilters.name: plate
imageFilters.purpose: Plate and gallery photographs, inside a Mat.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for every transition and animation.

motion.name: hero-turn
motion.value: turn 21s ease infinite on each panel's second photo; opacity 0 to 38%, 1 from 46% to 88%, 0 from 96%; panels 2 and 3 delayed 7s and 14s
motion.purpose: Hero triptych crossfade, one panel turning at a time; under reduce the second photos are hidden and the hero is static.

motion.name: page-lift
motion.value: fixed hero (z 0) under an in-flow spacer of calc(100svh - 53px); main and footer z 1 on White; hero visibility hidden once the spacer leaves the viewport (IntersectionObserver)
motion.purpose: The nav and page slide up over the still hero; desktop only.

motion.name: sheet
motion.value: opacity .45s ease, visibility after .45s on close; links from opacity 0, translateY(10px) over .6s, staggered .04s
motion.purpose: Mobile menu sheet entrance and exit; only under no-preference.

motion.name: burger
motion.value: top .25s then rotate(±45deg) .25s (reversed on close); middle line clears after .25s
motion.purpose: Burger to X morph; only under no-preference.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 1s ease, transform 1s ease; from translateY(14px); triggered at 15% intersection, once
motion.purpose: Plates and the contact block; only under no-preference.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: translateX(-50%) 44s linear infinite; paused on hover
motion.purpose: Media band; under reduce the animation is removed, the duplicate list hidden and the band scrolls horizontally.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Link, arrow, logo, field and submit hover or focus.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below: nav fixed at top, grid 44px 1fr 44px with burger, 22px logotype, Instagram; full-screen White menu sheet with 44px script links; hero is a block under the bar showing the middle panel only, spacer removed; plates collapse to blocks with 40px titles; footer grid becomes two columns.

placeholders: All photography is Unsplash stock, listed for replacement; each slot's filter applies to whatever replaces it.
Media band logos are public-domain wordmarks from Wikimedia Commons, not the designer's confirmed press list.
Gallery captions name outlets as placeholder provenance, not confirmed features.
Bebas Neue, Pinyon Script, Cormorant Garamond and Jost are free Google stand-ins for the reference's licensed Shelley Script, Nicolas Cochin EF and ITC Kabel.

narrative.northStar: The Show Title on a Lookbook
narrative.overview:
The homepage opens like a fashion show and continues like a lookbook. The first viewport is a grayscale triptych of three portrait photographs, fixed in place, each panel turning to a second photograph in turn; the only words on it are the white bar along its bottom edge, where the designer's name sits as a condensed Bebas Neue logotype between four small links. On scroll the bar rises with the page, which slides up over the still photographs and covers them. Everything after is quiet white plates in beige mats, one hairline band of press logos, a scroll row of matted gallery frames, a centered form and a paper-grey footer. Chrome is small, tracked caps so the photographs carry the page; density is deliberately low, one image and one title per plate.

The world is white ground and black ink with a single hairline weight between them, and a beige mat around every photograph below the hero. Four faces, each with one job: Bebas Neue sets the name; Pinyon Script sets every section title and the mobile menu; Cormorant Garamond 500 sets everything that is read; Jost sets every piece of chrome at 11px uppercase, tracked 0.2em. Nothing is bold. These are free Google stand-ins for the reference site's licensed faces (Shelley Script, Nicolas Cochin EF, ITC Kabel) and can be swapped for the licensed originals without changing the roles. There are no boxes, no shadows and no radius anywhere except the two circular gallery arrows. The hero photographs are forced to grayscale; plates and gallery frames keep muted colour (saturation 0.6) so the work reads as photographed, not as a filter.

Of the user's pinned palette (white, black, beige, grey) beige lands as Mat (#ebe8e4), the passe-partout around every plate and gallery photograph, and as Paper (#f5f4f1), the footer ground and the well behind a loading photograph. Rejected on evidence: the centered-logo card stack, colour accents, ornament.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, black ink, one hairline (1px); Mat frames every photograph below the hero, Paper holds the footer and the image wells.
Four faces, one job each: Bebas Neue for the name, Pinyon Script for titles and the mobile menu, Cormorant Garamond 500 for reading text, Jost 11px caps at 0.2em for chrome. Weight 400 or 500 only.
Fixed grayscale hero triptych the page and nav slide up over; plate and gallery photographs at 60% saturation in a 4:5 frame inside a Mat.
The only curve is the 44px circular gallery arrow; every other edge is square.
One easing curve (cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)), slow entrances, every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every rule, divider, ring, underline and burger line is 1px. On white it is Line; under a field it is Line field; a link underline is currentColor. No 2px rules, no borders around boxes, no hairline under the nav.

rules.name: The Passe-Partout Rule
rules.body: Every photograph below the hero sits in a Mat: padding clamp(7px, .8vw, 12px) of #ebe8e4 around the 4:5 image, square, no shadow, no border. Captions sit below the Mat, never inside it or over the photograph. The hero is the one unmatted image.

rules.name: The Paper Is a Ground Rule
rules.body: Paper fills the footer edge to edge and the well behind a photograph inside its Mat. It is never a panel, card or chip on white.

rules.name: The Monochrome Hero Rule
rules.body: The hero photographs are `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.02)`; every other photograph is `filter: saturate(.6)`. Any image replacing a placeholder inherits the filter of its slot.

rules.name: The One Face, One Job Rule
rules.body: Bebas Neue sets the name, Pinyon Script sets titles and the mobile menu, Cormorant Garamond sets reading and input text, Jost caps set chrome. A face never takes another face's job: no script label, no caps title, no Garamond button.

rules.name: The Logotype Only Rule
rules.body: Bebas Neue sets "Marketa Hajkova" (and its "MH" monogram) and nothing else. It is never used for a section title, a label, a button or a menu link; a new surface that needs a title sets it in the script.

rules.name: The Script Title Rule
rules.body: Every section title is Pinyon Script 400 at letter-spacing 0 and line-height 1.15, set all lowercase via text-transform (user decision 2026-10-30; the source copy keeps its capitals), never uppercase, never tracked. The mobile menu links keep their capitals. Plates and gallery are clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 52px), contact clamp(44px, 4vw, 58px), the Media heading 36px in Grey, the mobile menu 44px.

rules.name: The Nothing Bold Rule
rules.body: No element is set heavier than 500; Cormorant is 500, every other face 400. Emphasis comes from face and size, not weight.

rules.name: The One Chrome Size Rule
rules.body: All chrome is Jost 11px uppercase at 0.2em, line-height 1.2. A new label, button or caption takes the `.caps` style as is rather than a size or tracking of its own.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: `box-shadow`, `drop-shadow` and `backdrop-filter` do not appear in the build and are not to be introduced. Separation comes from a hairline, from the Mat, from Paper, or from the page sliding over the hero.

rules.name: The Clean Hero Rule
rules.body: Nothing is laid over the hero photographs: no text, no scrim, no gradient. The name lives on the bar beneath them; the h1 is visually hidden.

dos: Do set the name "Marketa Hajkova", and only the name, in Bebas Neue 400 uppercase at letter-spacing 0: 26px centered in the nav (22px mobile), 24px in the footer.

Do set every section title in Pinyon Script 400 at letter-spacing 0 and line-height 1.15, all lowercase: clamp(40px, 3.6vw, 52px) for plates and gallery (40px below 860px), clamp(44px, 4vw, 58px) for contact.
Do keep reading text at Cormorant Garamond 500, 18px/1.45, 0.02em (max 34 to 40ch), and every piece of chrome at Jost 400, 11px, uppercase, 0.2em.
Do run the hero photographs through `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.02)` and every other photograph through `filter: saturate(.6)`, cropped 4:5 inside a Mat.
Do frame every photograph below the hero in a square Mat of clamp(7px, .8vw, 12px), with its caption below the Mat.
Do draw every divider, ring and field edge as a 1px hairline (Line on white, Line field under inputs).
Do use the one easing curve for every transition and give every animation a reduced-motion path.
Do keep Paper to grounds: the footer and the image well.
donts: Don't introduce a hue. The palette is white, paper, mat, black, ink and grey; no accent.
Don't add shadows, backdrop blur, borders around boxes, or any radius other than the circular gallery arrows.
Don't place text, a scrim or a gradient over the hero photographs.
Don't place a dark or paper card, panel or chip on the white ground.
Don't use Bebas Neue for anything but the name and its monogram, or Pinyon Script for anything but titles and the mobile menu.
Don't set anything bold, set a title in uppercase or tracked, or give a piece of chrome its own size or tracking.
Don't add a second filled button; the submit is the only fill. Other actions are underlined links or circular line arrows.
Don't put a max-width container around sections; the gutter is the frame, and only the contact column is capped (560px).
Don't present the Unsplash photographs or the Wikimedia Commons logos as brand assets; both are placeholders listed for replacement.
